subject: math
question:
设命题：若函数 $f(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处连续，且

\lim _ {x \to 0} {\frac {f (2 x) - f (x)}{x}} = a (a \text {为常数}),

则 $f(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处可导，且 $f'(0) = a$ ：

判断该命题是否成立. 若成立，则给出证明；若不成立，则举出反例.

steps.text: 分析 由所给极限式可得到 $f(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 附近的局部表达式，再讨论是否有 $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{f(x) - f(0)}{x} = a$ .
f (2 x) = f (x) + a x + o (x) \quad (\text {在} x = 0 \text {附近}).

\begin{array}{r l} f (x) & = \left(f \left(\frac {x}{2 ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2 ^ {2}} (a x + o (x))\right) + \frac {1}{2} (a x + o (x)) = f \left(\frac {x}{2 ^ {2}}\right) + \left(\frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2 ^ {2}}\right) (a x + o (x)) \\ & = \dots = f \left(\frac {x}{2 ^ {n}}\right) + \left(\frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2 ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2 ^ {3}} + \dots + \frac {1}{2 ^ {n}}\right) (a x + o (x)). \end{array}
